_header: Stage-2 Gate-2 evaluation HOLDOUT — 30 specs, frozen under entry criterion E2.b (2026-07-05, Eric-approved). Append-never: changes require a PLAN amendment + Eric sign-off (PLAN 4). Frozen BEFORE the W2.1 funnel and before W2.3 training, so membership cannot be influenced by funnel/training results. The W2.1 decontamination MUST near-dup-remove these 30 specs' canonical text from chattla-corpora-v2. Gate-2 scores chattla-v2 vs the E2.c baseline on THIS set (pass@1 AND pass@32, Rule-9 semantic audit on every counted pass).

method.eligible_pool: the 163 closed_local specs in corpus/gate0_closed.json (reliably oracle-scorable at bounded budget; excludes 7 HPC-only, 13 deferred, 23 open/intractable)
method.budget_bound_rationale: = Stage-1 per-candidate TLC budget (corpus/configs/repair_budget.json defaults.timeout_s). Every holdout spec must close within the same budget the model gets at eval, else a correct model output is unscorable. Excludes spec 100 (canonical closure ~1012s).
method.stratification: proportional to eligible-pool population mix: state_machine 23, library 4, proof_module 2, expected_violation 1
method.selection: per stratum: sort pool, shuffle with Random(seed), walk in order skipping budget_excluded, take until quota filled
method.seed_source: int(sha256(corpus/gate0_closed.json)[:16], 16) — a function of already-frozen state, chosen with zero outcome knowledge (un-gameable)

validation.result: all 30 score as PASS under the Amendment-1/3 population criterion AND close within 120s (state_machine: SANY & non-vacuous TLC; library: SANY; proof_module: SANY & all TLAPS obligations; expected_violation: SANY & named property violated). Slowest: spec 14 @108s; run serial (--jobs 1) to avoid contention false-timeouts.
